extracted.intended_audience: SBIC licensees' finance officers/accountants preparing SBA periodic reports (forms/schedules)
extracted.subtask_description: Detailed instructions and line-item definitions for completing SBIC financial statements and schedules (items 19–49, Statement of Realized Gain or Loss on Investments, and Schedules 1–13). Intended to guide licensees in preparing required regulatory reports to SBA.

rubrics_metrics.name: 31. Taxes, excluding income taxes
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the amount of all taxes, including those on corporate premises owned, motor vehicle, and personal property, social security taxes (company’s portion), and other taxes charged to the company, exclusive of income taxes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 32. Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the amount of all travel expense, including transportation charges, automobile maintenance, operating expense, and depreciation expense; and meals, lodging, telephone, telegraph, and other company costs incurred by officers and employees while in a travel status.

rubrics_metrics.name: 33. Employee benefits expense
rubrics_metrics.description: State the cost assumed by the company in contributing to funds providing for employee retirement benefits and other types of employee benefits except group life insurance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 34. Organization expense
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of legal fees, promotional expense, stock certificate costs, incorporation fees, taxes, and other related costs incurred organizing the company which are charged to expense as incurred or are transferred to expense periodically through the amortization of such costs previously established as an asset.

rubrics_metrics.name: 35. Miscellaneous operating expenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the total amount of operating expenses not provided for elsewhere, meaning expenses incurred under contracts for management of the company; dues, subscriptions, donations, and similar items; charges for custodial or safekeeping services in connection with portfolio securities; bank service charges, exchange on one-day/other items, protest fees, etc.; and the cost of office supplies such as stationery, accounting binders, pencils, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: 36–39. Unclassified items
rubrics_metrics.description: Placeholders for unclassified operating expense items (items 36 through 39) as shown on the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: 40. Total Operating Expenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter total of items 19 through 39.

rubrics_metrics.name: 41. Other expenses (nonoperating)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the total amount of nonoperating expenses not provided for elsewhere, including compensation or charges for financial services received from [other] companies in connection with participations purchased.

rubrics_metrics.name: 42. Total Expenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the total of items 18, 40, and 41.

rubrics_metrics.name: 43. Net Operating Income before provision for probable losses and income taxes
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the balance resulting from the deduction of item 42 from item 13.

rubrics_metrics.name: 44. Provision for probable losses on receivables
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the amount provided during the fiscal year to date for losses on notes and accounts receivable, and interest receivable.

rubrics_metrics.name: 45. Provision for probable losses on loans, investments, and other assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the amount provided during the fiscal year to date for estimated losses on loans (section 305); debt securities of small business concerns (section 304); capital stock of small business concerns; warrants, options, and other stock rights acquired from SBCs; and assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 46. Net Operating Income before provision for income taxes
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the balance resulting from the deduction of the appropriate amount opposite item 45 from item 43.

rubrics_metrics.name: 47. Federal income taxes—net income
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the amount of Federal income taxes for the fiscal year to date relating to net income exclusive of net realized gain or loss on investments.

rubrics_metrics.name: 48. State and other income taxes—net income
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the amount of State and other non-Federal income taxes for the fiscal year to date relating to net income exclusive of net realized gain or loss on investments.

rubrics_metrics.name: 49. Net Income (Loss) From Operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the balance resulting from the deduction of the appropriate amount opposite item 48 from item 46.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Realized Gain or Loss on Investments — 1. U.S. Government securities
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the aggregate cost, aggregate net proceeds, and net gain or net loss on the sale or other disposition of U.S. Government obligations, direct and fully guaranteed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For items 1 through 7 use appropriate columns as explained in footnotes (a) and (b) on the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Realized Gain or Loss on Investments — 2. Debt securities of SBCs
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the aggregate cost less allowance for losses, aggregate net proceeds, and net gain or loss on the sale or other disposition of debt securities of small business concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Realized Gain or Loss on Investments — 3. Capital stock of SBCs
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the aggregate cost less allowance for losses, aggregate net proceeds, and net gain or loss on the sale or other disposition of capital stock of small business concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Realized Gain or Loss on Investments — 4. Warrants, options, and other stock rights acquired from SBCs
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the aggregate cost less allowance for losses, aggregate net proceeds, and net gain or loss on the sale or other disposition of warrants, options, and other stock rights acquired from small business concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Realized Gain or Loss on Investments — Assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the aggregate cost less allowance for losses, aggregate net proceeds, and net gain or loss on the sale or other disposition of assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities of small business concerns. The aggregate cost shown shall be the basis determined by the board of directors (including agreed consideration, fair appraised value, etc.) and shall not exceed totals related to the loan or debt security involved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any allowance for losses should be shown; items not included in the investor’s portfolio should be excluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: 7. Net Gain and/or Loss on Investments
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the net total of items 1 through 6.

rubrics_metrics.name: 8. Combined Net Gain (Loss) on Investments
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the balance resulting from the deduction of item 7, column (5) from item 7, column (4).

rubrics_metrics.name: 9. Less portion of gain not realised in cash
rubrics_metrics.description: State the amount of that part of gain represented by proceeds other than cash, demand certificates of deposit issued by FDIC-member banks, and/or negotiable direct obligations of the U.S. Government.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10. Net Realised Gain (Loss) on Investments before provision for income taxes
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the balance resulting from the deduction of item 9 from item 8.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11. Federal taxes—net realised gain on investments
rubrics_metrics.description: State the amount of estimated Federal income taxes applicable to net realized gain on investments for the fiscal year to date.

rubrics_metrics.name: 12. State and other income taxes—net realised gain on investments
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the amount of estimated State and other non-Federal income taxes applicable to net realized gain on investments for the fiscal year to date.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13. Total provision for income taxes (realized gains)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the total of items 11 and 12.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14. Net Realised Gain (Loss) on Investments
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the balance resulting from the deduction of item 13 from item 10.

rubrics_metrics.name: Note on Statement of Realized Gain or Loss
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the transactions in this Statement in accordance with the instructions set forth in the note at the bottom of the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Loans and Debt Securities: scope & items to list
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish a summary of all loans (section 305) and debt securities (section 304) setting forth the pertinent data indicated by the column headings. Items to be listed include all loans held, made, obtained, or disposed of by the company during the fiscal year to date, and all debt securities held, acquired, converted, or disposed of during such period. Participations are included but only the reporting company's portion is shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Identification and required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: List each loan and debt security by employer identification number; Standard Industrial Classification code; name and full address of financed small business concern; type (loan or debt security); financing number; interest rate; date and maturity date; principal balance at beginning of period; additions during period; deductions during period; and principal balance at close of period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Totals in column (11) for loans must agree with item 9 of the Statement of Financial Condition; totals for debt securities must agree with item 10.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Column 12: allowance for losses
rubrics_metrics.description: Show in column 12 for each loan and debt security any allowance for losses established for such item on the basis of the estimated realizable value of the individual item, or any portion of an overall allowance established on a percentage or other basis which has been allocated to the individual item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Column 13: market/fair value rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Show in column 13 the market value, or fair value as determined by the board of directors, of each debt security determined to be worth more than cost and each loan or debt security determined to be worth less than cost, minus any allowance for losses as shown in column 12. Any loan or debt security with an allowance for losses shall not be listed in column 13 at any value higher than cost less such allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Explanatory notation for loans from another Licensee
rubrics_metrics.description: An explanatory notation or footnote shall be entered in the schedule with respect to any loan or debt security (or any interest therein) obtained from another Licensee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Notes (a) Grouping financings
rubrics_metrics.description: Group together the financing for each small business concern and classify each financing by category (loan or debt security) in column (4), treating multiple disbursements under the same financing agreement as a single financing. Show totals of each category and the grand totals on the last sheet of the schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Notes (b) Employer ID and SIC code
rubrics_metrics.description: In column (1) enter the employer identification number of each listed small business concern; if none, obtain one via Form SS-4. In column (2) enter the 4-digit SIC code of the principal industry for the concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Notes (c) Financing number rules
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Licensee has had more than one financing in the same category outstanding to the same concern (cumulative beginning with Mar. 31, 1966), assign each such similar financing a financing number (1-2-3, etc.) and show it in column (5). A number once assigned to a specific financing for a small business concern should never be reassigned to another financing in the same category to the same concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Notes (d) Identification P/E/V and venture capital total
rubrics_metrics.description: In column (11) identify each item 'pledged' or 'earmarked' by letter (P) or (E), as appropriate. Also identify by the letter (V) each item qualifying under the regulations as venture capital. Show the total of all venture capital amounts immediately under the 'Grand Totals' line at the foot of column (11).

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 1 — Notes (e) Column 14 percentage of voting securities
rubrics_metrics.description: Show in column (14) opposite each debt security financing the percentage of the financed small business concern's voting securities which has been and/or can be obtained by the Licensee through exercise of conversion privileges and/or stock purchase warrants or options received in connection with the financing. Compute without consideration of simultaneous exercise by others. If important to disclose action of others, append a footnote explaining actual and potential ownership including names and percentages of other investors and general terms of their stock rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Capital stock of SBCs and warrants/options: scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish a summary of all investments (section 304), other than debt securities, including capital stock held, acquired, converted, or disposed of during the fiscal year to date, and all warrants, options, and other stock rights acquired from SBCs which were held, obtained, surrendered, expired or sold during such period. Participations included but only reporting company's portion shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Identification and required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: List each investment by employer identification number; SIC code; name and address of financed concern; type (stock, warrant, option); financing number; date; balance at cost at beginning of period; cost of additions; cost of deductions; and balance at cost at close of period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Totals in column (10) for capital stock shall agree with item 11 of Statement of Financial Condition; totals for warrants/options shall agree with item 12.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Column 11 allowance for losses
rubrics_metrics.description: Show in column (11) for each investment any allowance for losses established on the basis of estimated realizable value of the individual item or allocation from an overall allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Column 12 market/fair value rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Show in column (12) the market value, or fair value as determined by the board of directors, of each investment determined to be worth more than cost and each investment worth less than cost, minus any allowance for losses shown in column (11). Investments with an allowance shall not be listed in column (12) at any value higher than cost less such allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Explanatory notation for investments from another Licensee
rubrics_metrics.description: An explanatory notation or footnote shall be entered with respect to any investment (or interest therein) obtained from another Licensee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Notes (a) Grouping financings
rubrics_metrics.description: Group financings for each small business concern; classify each financing by category (stock or warrants or options) in column (4), treating multiple disbursements under same financing agreement as single financing. Show totals of each category and grand totals on last sheet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Notes (b) Employer ID and SIC code
rubrics_metrics.description: In column (1) enter employer identification number; if none, obtain via Form SS-4. In column (2) enter the 4-digit SIC code of the principal industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Notes (c) Financing number rules
rubrics_metrics.description: If more than one financing in same category outstanding to same concern (cumulative beginning Mar. 31, 1966), assign financing numbers (1-2-3) for identification and show in column (5); numbers once assigned should never be reassigned to another financing in same category to same concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 2 — Notes (d) Identification P/E/V and venture capital disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: In column (10) identify each item 'pledged' or 'earmarked' by letter (P) or (E); also identify by (V) items qualifying as venture capital. Show total of all venture capital amounts under the 'Grand Totals' line. In column (13) opposite each financing item show percentage of financed concern's voting securities obtainable by the Licensee through conversion/warrants/options or represented by the financing item itself; compute without considering simultaneous exercise by others. If action of others affects ownership, append footnote with adjusted percentages, names of other investors, and general terms of their stock rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 3 — Details of certain loans and investments: conditions for inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter in Schedule 3 all loans and debt securities shown in Schedule 1 and all investments shown in Schedule 2 concerning which any of the following conditions exist: (1) new or additional financing furnished during the period; (2) terms of existing financing amended and/or collateral changed during fiscal year; (3) rescheduling, refinancing, or refunding of principal/interest occurred or conversion of a delinquent item has taken place during fiscal year; (4) installment payments past due more than 1 month.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 3 — Required details and columns
rubrics_metrics.description: List items by employer identification number (column 1) and identify them by name, type of financing, and financing number (columns 2–4). In column (5) show original principal amount or other cost. Column (6) shall set forth details of amortization plan and other significant provisions of the financing instrument, including precise description of capital stock of SBCs. Columns (7) and (8) present value and description of collateral respectively and indicate portion assigned as security in column (8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If any loans/debt securities earmarked or pledged to SBA are in default as to payment or covenants, include repayment delinquencies in Schedule 4 and describe other defaults in column (6). Identify earmarked/pledged items by (E) or (P). If none are in default, state that on Schedule 3.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 4 — Allowance for Losses on Investments—Delinquent Loans and Debt Securities: scope
rubrics_metrics.description: List all loans and investments for which an allowance for losses has been established or which (if loans or debt securities) are delinquent with installment payments past due more than 1 month. Identify each item in column (1) by employer identification number and name; indicate type of financing in column (2) and financing number in column (3) if multiple financings exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 4 — Allowance accounting columns
rubrics_metrics.description: In columns (4) through (8) show the opening balance of the allowance for losses on each security, the additions and deductions pertaining to such allowance, and the closing balance, all relating to the fiscal year to date. If an overall allowance exists not allocated to individual securities, show its beginning and ending balances and changes on the 'General allowance' line. Grand total of column (8) shall equal the sum of items 9(b), 10(b), 11(a), and 12(a) in the Statement of Financial Condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 4 — Delinquency and related columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Show in column (9) the principal balance or other cost as of close of period. In columns (10) and (11) show all installments of principal and/or interest past due more than one month on loans and debt securities. Identify and classify portfolio items in columns (1)–(3) and include any allowances for losses related thereto in the provided columns. Identify earmarked/pledged items to SBA by letters (E) or (P).

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 5 — Assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities
rubrics_metrics.description: List and describe, by former debtors (small business concerns), assets carried during fiscal year in the account for assets acquired in liquidation of loans (section 305) and debt securities (section 304). Show balance at beginning of reporting period, additions and deductions during the period, and balance at close of period in specified columns. Record allowance for losses established for the items and the company's portion of such assets. Show market value or fair value as determined by board of directors at close of period in the appropriate column. Totals of columns shall agree with specified items in the Statement of Financial Condition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify in column (6) by letter (V) each asset acquired in liquidation of a portfolio security which original security qualified as venture capital; show total of such secondary venture capital amounts under last line at foot of column (6).

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 6 — Participations and Joint Financings
rubrics_metrics.description: Show all financings in which the reporting company participated and all financings made jointly by the reporting company and one or more other lenders/investors during the fiscal year to date, or which were outstanding at any time during such period. Identify each item by employer identification number and name; indicate type of financing in column (2); enter financing number in column (3) if multiple financings to same concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 6 — Participations columns
rubrics_metrics.description: In column (4) show original total amount contributed by all parties in participation or joint financing. List names of participating/joint financing entities (including reporting company) in column (5) with indication of initiating (sponsoring) entity. Show in columns (6), (7), or (8) the reporting company's outstanding principal balance or other cost of participation purchased, participation sold, or joint financing as of close of period. Enter in column (9) a description of collateral and information as to percentage applicable to each party and any preferences agreed upon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 7 — Cash, U.S. Government Obligations, Insured Savings, and Time Deposits (Schedule 7a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Schedule 7a: show all cash on hand and in general funds demand deposits; funds in imprest bank accounts; funds on time deposit evidenced by time certificates of deposit. Demand deposits are balances subject to withdrawal without notice and shall be in commercial banks which are members of FDIC. Cash items in process of collection represent cash items placed with banks for collection. Petty cash shall represent full amount of petty cash imprest fund.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 7 — U.S. Government obligations and insured savings (Schedule 7b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Schedule 7b(1): list all securities owned which have been issued or guaranteed by the U.S. Government, showing issuer and title of each issue and other required data (interest rate, call date, date, principal amount at par). Show cost in column (6) and current market value in column (7). Schedule 7b(2): list all funds invested in insured savings accounts and all funds on time deposit evidenced by time certificates of deposit held by the company in commercial banks which are members of FDIC or in institutions insured by Federal Savings and Loan Insurance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time deposits include all time of deposit held by the company.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 8 — Due From Directors, Officers, and Employees
rubrics_metrics.description: List amounts made to directors, officers, and employees for [debtor?] in the required columns. Show unpaid amount at beginning of fiscal year in column (2); additions, writeoffs, and collections during fiscal year to date in columns (3), (4), and (5); and balance at close in column (6). Total of column (6) shall agree with item 6 in Statement of Financial Condition. Furnish explanation for any amount written off or any collection other than in cash.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 9 — Commitments Outstanding
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish a summary showing separately, with subtotals, (1) commitments to small business concerns for equity financing under section 304, (2) commitments to small business concerns for loans under section 305, and (3) commitments to banks or other lenders for deferred participations in loans or commitments to small business concerns. Show total amount of all commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 9 — Guarantees and contingent liabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Separately set forth all obligations of portfolio concerns guaranteed by the company, showing date of guarantee, name of debtor small business concern, name of lender, and outstanding amount of guarantee. Show total outstanding amount of all guarantees. Separately set forth, with total, all other contingent liabilities. Show grand total of all commitments, guarantees, and other contingent liabilities at bottom of schedule; this amount shall be the same as given in the footnote at bottom of page 2 of the report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 10 — Obligations Payable: categories and grouping
rubrics_metrics.description: Shown in this schedule, by creditors, all obligations payable representing categories: (1) SBA section 302 funds, (2) SBA direct loans (section 303), (3) guaranteed loans purchased by SBA (section 303), (4) loans guaranteed by SBA (section 303), (5) loans not guaranteed by SBA, (6) mortgages payable for funds borrowed, and (7) mortgages payable on assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities. Liabilities shall be grouped by these categories and described in column (2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guaranteed loans purchased by SBA represent section 303 loans originally financed by banks which have been transferred to SBA through reassignment, transfer, and delivery of the notes to SBA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 10 — Terms, balances, and column agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Record interest rate and other terms of each obligation in columns (3) and (4); unpaid balance at beginning of fiscal year and additions/deductions during fiscal year to date in columns (5), (6), and (7); and the balance payable at close segregated between (a) amounts owed to SBA for funds borrowed and (b) amounts owed to others for funds borrowed and/or mortgages payable on assets acquired in liquidation in columns (8) and (9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total of column (8) shall agree with total of items 29 and 34 of Statement of Financial Condition; total of column (9) shall agree with total of items 13(b), 30, and 31 and the appropriate amount opposite item 32 of such statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 11 — Capital Stock of Licensee: description and columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish complete description of company's capital stock authorized, issued and outstanding, and data relating to special transactions. Column (1) describe type and class of each issue and par or stated value. Column (2) show number of shares authorized. Columns (3) and (4) show number of shares issued and not retired and amount at par or stated value (total of column (4) shall agree with item 36 of Statement). Column (5) number of shares held as treasury stock. Column (6) difference between column (3) and column (5). Column (7) amount at par representing number of shares outstanding. Column (8) amount of capital stock subscribed at subscription price (agree with item 40 of Statement). Column (9) amount of subscriptions receivable (agree with item 40(a)). Column (10) number of shares reserved for purchase by officers and employees; column (11) number of shares reserved to cover options and other rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 12 — Options on Licensee’s Capital Stock
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish full information concerning outstanding capital stock options granted by the company. Identify holder in column (1); number of shares optioned in column (2); type/class of stock in column (3); grant and expiration dates in column (4); price(s) and periods exercisable in column (5); fair market value per share at date option granted in column (6); price exercisable as percentage of fair market value at date of granting in column (7); provisions for optionee's death, retirement, or other circumstances in column (8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fair market value per share at grant date, if not ascertainable from actual market, shall be as determined by the board of directors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 13 — Ownership of Equity Securities of SBIC
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish information regarding equity securities issued by the Licensee and regarding the Licensee's officers, directors, and employees. In column (1) list: (a) each person or company directly or indirectly owning, controlling, or holding with power to vote 5% or more of outstanding voting securities; (b) each person or company owning of record or known to own beneficially more than 10% of any other class of equity securities; (c) each officer and director (list all regardless of ownership); (d) each employee (list all including salaried officers and directors regardless of ownership) and show whether full-time or part-time.
